Class GeologicalResourceMapRasterizer

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.data.GeologicalResourceMapRasterizer
public final class GeologicalResourceMapRasterizer extends Object

Geological Resource Map Rasterizer

Dedicated rasterizer for lithospheric mineral, fossil, geothermal, and hydrological resource layers. Extracts and compiles global empirical and historical occurrences into high-resolution 2D cartographic tensors:

  • Coal Basins: USGS MRDS and empirical Permian/Carboniferous deposits (e.g., Shanxi, Newcastle, Ruhr, Appalachia).
  • Petroleum invalid input: '&' Bitumen: Giant petroleum systems (Ghawar, Burgan, Permian Basin) and historical surface seeps (Dead Sea, Hit, Baku, Pitch Lake).
  • Natural Gas: Major conventional gas reservoirs (South Pars, Urengoy, Groningen) and ancient bamboo brine drillings.
  • Uranium invalid input: '&' Thorium: IAEA NFCIS metallogenic provinces (Athabasca, Olympic Dam, Chu-Sarysu).
  • Lunar Helium-3: Regolith volatilization reserve maps.
  • Base Metals (Iron invalid input: '&' Copper): Banded Iron Formations (Pilbara, Carajás, Krivoy Rog) and ancient smelting centers (Rio Tinto, Cyprus, Elba, Noricum).
  • Precious Metals (Gold, Silver, PGEs): Hydraulic roman placer mines (Las Médulas), Witwatersrand, Potosí, Carlin Trend.
  • Rare Earth Elements (REE invalid input: '&' Lithium): Carbonatites (Bayan Obo, Mountain Pass) and salt flat brines (Atacama, Uyuni).
  • Mantle Heat Flow: Ingestion of Davies 2013 spherical grid (2° resolution) via bilinear interpolation.
  • Aquifers invalid input: '&' Groundwater Tables: UNESCO WHYMAP shapefile polygon ingestion and paleo-recharge pluvial factors ($\Delta t$).
